# Sanity projections

Small GROQ snippets that say which fields to pull for a content type, so queries don't repeat them.

## What's here

- One folder per content type (`project/`, `image/`, `navigation/`, and so on)
- `index.js`: exports them all

## How it connects

- Used inside [queries](../queries/README.md).

## See also

- [Sanity data](../README.md)
